name: mcp-openbb
test_commands: docker run --rm --entrypoint python "$IMAGE_REF" -c "from importlib.metadata import version; expected={'openbb-core':'2.0.1','openbb-mcp-server':'2.0.1','openbb-sec':'2.0.0','openbb-fred':'2.0.0','openbb-ecb':'2.0.0','openbb-imf':'3.0.0','openbb-cboe':'2.0.0','openbb-nasdaq':'2.0.0','openbb-bls':'2.0.0'}; actual={name:version(name) for name in expected}; print(actual); assert actual == expected; from openbb_core.app.utils import get_user_cache_directory; assert get_user_cache_directory() == '/cache'; import importlib.util; assert importlib.util.find_spec('openbb_cli') is None"
